info.title: API.SH: 1stDibs
info.description: The 1stDibs API from API.SH: public 1stDibs data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
What the 1stDibs search box suggests for a few letters: popular searches, categories, dealers, creators and collections, each with its slug and page link.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/1stdibs-autocomplete

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Comma separated: popular, category, seller, creator, collection (default all).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The categories under a 1stDibs section, with item counts and page paths, plus the section's category tiles, breadcrumbs and the other filters it offers. Pass a returned path back as `path` to go one level deeper, or to /1stdibs/v1/search to list its items.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/1stdibs-categories

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A designer, maker, brand or artist on 1stDibs: name, biography, questions and answers, related creators, articles and the about sections, with the creator's items for sale (same filters, sorts and item fields as /1stdibs/v1/search). Narrow to one section with `category`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/1stdibs-creator

parameters.description: Creator slug (e.g. gio-ponti) or the creator page URL.

parameters.name: item_type

parameters.name: style
parameters.description: Style values from `filters` (e.g. mid-century-modern, art-deco); comma separated for several.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: Place of origin values from `filters` (e.g. scandinavian, italian).

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Where the item is, a value from the location filter (e.g. continental-us, europe).

parameters.name: production_time

parameters.name: matching_sets
parameters.description: Single piece or set size values from `filters` (e.g. single-piece, set-2).

parameters.name: measurement_unit
parameters.description: Unit of the size filters: in (default) or cm.

parameters.name: recognized_seller

parameters.name: top_seller
parameters.description: true: listings of top sellers only.

parameters.name: strategic_partner

parameters.name: currency

get.description:
Buyer reviews of a 1stDibs dealer: rating, text, language, date, the reviewer's first name when the site shows one, photos and the item bought (id, title, link, image), with the dealer's average rating, review total and star breakdown. Filter by star rating; sort newest, highest, lowest or with photos first. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/1stdibs-dealer-reviews

parameters.name: dealer
parameters.description: Dealer slug, dealer page URL or seller id (e.g. f_9711).

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only reviews with this many stars (1-5).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The 1stDibs seller directory: dealers and galleries with id, name, slug, link, location, on 1stDibs since, distinguished, diamond and top seller flags, logo and banner. Search by name, narrow to a vertical or to distinguished or top sellers. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/1stdibs-dealers

get.description:
Values of one 1stDibs search filter that match a few letters (e.g. every creator starting with "pon"), with item counts and the page path, within a section. Use a returned `value` as that filter on /1stdibs/v1/search.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/1stdibs-filter-values

parameters.description: creator, material, origin or location (style, period and color list all their values in the search `filters`).

get.description:
One 1stDibs listing: title, price in the chosen currency and every other currency, price on request, availability, sold and on-hold status, full description, creators and their role, every detail row the page shows (creator, dimensions, style, materials, place of origin, period, date of manufacture, condition, seller location, reference number...), measurements, categories, item location, returns, lead time, variants, the dealer (id, name, location, business phone, rating, review count, response time, orders, member since, tier badges, about), breadcrumbs, all photos, video, views, the creator story tabs, similar items and `raw`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/1stdibs-item

get.description:
Search or browse 1stDibs (furniture, art, jewelry, fashion) with every filter the site's listings take: keywords or any listing page (`path`, e.g. a category, style, creator or collection page), item type, style, period, material, origin, creator, color, item location, lead time, matching sets, price range in any of ten currencies, width, height and depth ranges, sale, new this week, customizable, returnable and seller-tier filters, in five sort orders. Each item: id, title, link, price in the chosen currency with the price in every currency, sale price and percent off, sold, on hold, dealer (id and name), location and country, creators, period, origin, style, materials, creation date, measurements (in, cm, mm), category, description excerpt, shipping quotes by region, images and `raw`. Also returns the filters with every value's count and page path, the applied filters, sort options, breadcrumbs, category tiles, related searches and, under thin results, the previously available (sold) items with their last price (`sold_items`). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page (the site serves about 6,000 results per listing).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/1stdibs-search

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
